scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained using classical Chinese remainder, Möbius, and Jordan-totient identities. Direct exact computations reproduce finite cases but do not certify the infinite asymptotic or originality.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns uniform sampling over a complete least-common-multiple period. It establishes a second moment and a Chebyshev concentration bound, not a central limit theorem, short-interval law or absolute priority against unindexed equivalent treatments.
title: Exact complete-period variance and cubic concentration of modular energy
